title: Undoing a WordPress look write that created the site's Additional CSS post deletes that post instead of leaving it empty
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/look-undo.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/look-set.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/look-css.test.mjs
S2: Read the tests named in run.tests (the plugin's look.revert and look.set, and tracy-host's site-look-css turn undo, against a WordPress that plays WP_CUSTOM_CSS_PHP).
expect: A site with no custom_css post: the read says exists:false, the undo entry records customCss.existed:false, and look.revert (and a LOOK_SET_NO_EFFECT put-back) sends mode 'remove' — the post the write created is gone afterwards, restored ['Additional CSS'].
tracy-host's turn undo of such an entry sends mode 'remove' with expect = sha256 of c1, and the check then reads now == before.
An entry kept before `existed` was recorded (c0 empty, no flag) is put back as an empty post, as before; the plugin and tracy-host copies of WP_CUSTOM_CSS_PHP stay identical.

selectors.code: look-undo.mjs takeLookSnapshot / revertLook; look-css.js lookCss undo

evidence: uiweekwp 09/10/2026: no custom_css post before look.set; after look.set + turn undo the site has post 2093 'wp-tracy-business' with empty content (created 18:17:28 by the write, emptied 18:18:00 by the undo); undo entry f737fe has c0 = 0 bytes and no way to tell 'none' from 'empty'.
fence: the Additional CSS read reports whether the post exists; the undo record keeps it; a revert of a created post deletes it compare-and-set

tests: 🔒 WordPress Additional CSS a look write CREATED is deleted by its undo
🔒 WordPress: a site with no Additional CSS post gets none back
🔒 undo of a write that CREATED the Additional CSS post
🔒 the PHP, its argv, the store and the id shape are the plugin’s own
